candidates.name: Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy

ST-segment elevation in leads II, III, and aVF
subtle ST-segment elevation in leads V7-V9

candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis may be overlooked if the focus is solely on the coronary artery occlusion, and the unique ECG and clinical features of Takotsubo cardiomyopathy are not considered.
